correctness.rationale: In A_n, total partial-function extensions form {1,2}^n. The back condition prohibits any maximal point mapping to 0, so every p-morphism determines a 2-coloring of maxima. Monotonicity forces f(x)=1 or 2 for a monochromatic cylinder M(x); if f(x)=0 with monochromatic M(x), back condition yields a forbidden opposite-colored total extension. Mixed cylinders must map to 0 by monotonicity. Conversely the proposed coloring map is monotone because M(y)⊆M(x) for x≤y; its back condition is witnessed by a full extension of each color, or x itself. Hence all 2^{2^n} mappings correspond bijectively and exactly two constants are not onto. Direct independent exhaustive enumerations verified all 4 p-morphisms for n=1 and 16 for n=2, with 2 and 14 onto. No claim about target A_m,m>1.

Classifying every bounded morphism onto this target is a motivated complete hom-set invariant, showing that arbitrary Boolean functions on 2^n maximal assignments (not only coordinate projections) arise and giving the exact onto count. The proof is short but the natural all-n mapping classification is not an arbitrary tiny slice.
